question: Using a straight-line trend fitted to monthly completed revenue from January 2024 to December 2025, what is the forecast for January 2026?
plan: The question asks for a forecast, a projection or a fitted trend line: get the series it is fitted on (one row per period), fit it from that series, and report each forecast with its period.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH monthly_rev AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS ym, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS rev FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY ym), indexed_rev AS (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ym) AS x, rev AS y FROM monthly_rev), stats AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(x) AS sum_x, SUM(y) AS sum_y, SUM(x * x) AS sum_xx, SUM(x * y) AS sum_xy FROM indexed_rev) SELECT (CAST(sum_xy AS REAL) - (CAST(sum_x AS REAL) * sum_y / n)) / (CAST(sum_xx AS REAL) - (CAST(sum_x AS REAL) * sum_x / n)) AS slope, (sum_y - ((CAST(sum_xy AS REAL) - (CAST(sum_x AS REAL) * sum_y / n)) / (CAST(sum_xx AS REAL) - (CAST(sum_x AS REAL) * sum_x / n))) * sum_x) / n AS intercept, ((sum_y - ((CAST(sum_xy AS REAL) - (CAST(sum_x AS REAL) * sum_y / n)) / (CAST(sum_xx AS REAL) - (CAST(sum_x AS REAL) * sum_x / n))) * sum_x) / n) + (((CAST(sum_xy AS REAL) - (CAST(sum_x AS REAL) * sum_y / n)) / (CAST(sum_xx AS REAL) - (CAST(sum_x AS REAL) * sum_x / n))) * 25) AS forecast_jan_2026 FROM stats LIMIT 500
